press_references.value: Careem and MAJRA launch UAE-wide summer initiatives for Captains

partnership_announcements.description: Careem has partnered with MAJRA National CSR Fund and PepsiCo to run the 2026 Captain Summer Initiatives, a four‑month UAE-wide program providing rest areas, health screenings, and refreshments for over 80,000 delivery workers.

press_references.value: Careem Pay Partners with Adyen for UAE Digital Remittance Expansion

partnership_announcements.description: Careem Pay has deepened and extended its long-standing partnership with Adyen, which will now provide underlying payments infrastructure to scale Careem Pay’s UAE-based digital remittance services for cross-border transfers to over 35 countries.

press_references.value: Careem Launches on Huawei AppGallery, Reaching 90 Million Users

partnership_announcements.description: Careem and Huawei announced a new strategic partnership to make the Careem super app available on Huawei AppGallery and integrate it more deeply across Huawei Mobile Services devices in the Middle East.

press_references.value: Careem and Flyby take advertising from the Everything App to the Street

partnership_announcements.description: Careem formed a strategic partnership with Flyby to integrate Flyby’s smart moving digital OOH advertising boxes with Careem’s delivery fleet and in-app ad ecosystem, enabling synchronized digital and street-level campaigns in Dubai.

press_references.value: Careem Shops brings iPhone 17 to Jordan through an exclusive partnership with Apple Authorized Reseller Cell Bay
press_references.publisher: Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA

partnership_announcements.description: Careem Shops announced an exclusive partnership with Apple Authorized Reseller CellBay to sell the iPhone 17 and other Apple devices in Jordan, offering pre-orders ahead of launch and now immediate purchases via the Careem app.

press_references.value: WFP partners with Careem to deliver food aid in Gaza

partnership_announcements.description: Careem and the World Food Programme (WFP) have announced a new partnership to enable in-app donations for emergency food aid in Gaza and the West Bank, allowing Careem users in Jordan and the UAE to directly support WFP's relief efforts.

press_references.value: Careem partners with Bustanica to deliver pesticide-free, locally grown produce to UAE customers

partnership_announcements.description: Careem has partnered with Bustanica to deliver pesticide-free, locally grown produce to customers in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. This partnership leverages Careem's technology platform and delivery network to provide fresh produce from Bustanica's vertical farm.

product_launches.description: Careem launched Careem Food Catering in the UAE, allowing customers to pre-book catering from more than 20 providers in Dubai and Abu Dhabi through the Careem app.

press_references.value: Careem's Far-Away Gems brings Dubai and Abu Dhabi's most-loved restaurants to your door

product_launches.description: Careem launched Far-Away Gems, a new food-delivery feature in its app that doubles delivery range and surfaces over 600 hand-picked restaurants across Dubai and Abu Dhabi that were previously out of reach for most customers.

press_references.value: Careem Pay Adds Türkiye and Saudi Arabia to UAE Remittance Network

product_launches.description: Careem Pay has launched new remittance corridors from the UAE to Türkiye and Saudi Arabia, enabling fast, low-fee bank-to-bank international transfers via the Careem app.

press_references.value: Careem Food introduces the first Meal Scheduling in Jordan
press_references.publisher: Jordan News | Latest News from Jordan, MENA

product_launches.description: Careem launched a new Meal Scheduling feature on its Careem Food service in Jordan, allowing customers to pre-schedule food deliveries hours or days in advance with precise delivery times.

press_references.value: Careem Launches Corporate Payments Across Multiple Services

product_launches.description: Careem introduced a corporate payments solution under Careem for Business, enabling companies in the UAE to centrally manage and pay for employee spending across rides, food and grocery delivery, logistics, and shops with controls and consolidated invoicing.

press_references.value: UAE's Careem wants to help with 'curated' meals - grocery lists too

product_launches.description: Careem has launched 'Meals:ON', a curated meal plan service initially rolled out in Abu Dhabi and then Dubai, aiming to simplify food ordering for solo customers and build repeat usage.

press_references.value: Careem expands in Al Ain with the launch of Careem Food

product_launches.description: Careem has launched its Careem Food service in Al Ain, UAE, expanding its food delivery offerings to a new city and providing residents with access to a wide range of local and regional restaurants.

press_references.value: Careem Launches Grocery Delivery Service ‘Market’ in Riyadh

product_launches.description: Careem has launched a new grocery delivery service called 'Careem Market' in Riyadh, providing quick access to fresh produce and household essentials through its app. The service is available in 24 neighborhoods and utilizes dark stores for fast delivery.

press_references.value: UAE Quick Commerce Market to Grow at a CAGR of 3.72% During 2026-2032, Driven by Rising Demand for Ultra-Fast Delivery and Digital Retail Expansion | MarkNtel Advisors

product_launches.description: Careem plans to launch Careem Quik, a 15-minute quick-commerce delivery service in the UAE focused on ultra-fast delivery of groceries and electronics as part of its broader last-mile ecosystem strategy.

press_references.value: Careem Groceries launches in Abu Dhabi with 20-minute delivery

product_launches.description: Careem has expanded its grocery delivery service to Abu Dhabi, offering 20-minute delivery times across the city.

overview_description.description: Careem operates a car booking platform that connects passengers with local drivers. The company's platform provides a marketplace of community drivers where passengers can request a ride in minutes, see the cost, and have it charged to their credit card of choice, giving passengers access to affordable and advantageous transportation.
